name: Kusunoki Yuuta
source:
The protagonist of the story. A boy who attends a private affiliated school. 

With a strong sense of responsibility and a will to take action, he's not the type to throw in the towel. While his height is average compared to boys his age, his reflexes are excellent. He's the ace striker of their soccer club. 

As both of his parents are working and is mostly out of the house, his [url=https://vndb.org/c45514]aunt[/url] who was just a student back then looked after him when he was young.

Since then, he's held feelings of love towards his aunt, but shortly after Ikumi started working, she got married.

[Translated from [url=http://www.boot.eroit.net/bokuoba/chara02.html]Official Site[/url]]
